name: Astorga (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Astorga (a tree on red within a yellow bordure).
history: The rectangular flag of Astorga is described as a red flag with the arms at the centre; the city bears the titles Muy Noble, Leal, Benemérita, Magnífica y Augusta.

features.role: Astorga arms — tree on red within a bordure
bordure and crown of the arms
